name: Treasure Clues Provided by Someone Mysterious

children.text: Go to the Audition Shuttle in the Audition Plaza. Make a third choice. Reunite with your people at the end of the road.
Go to the Audition Shuttle in the Audition Plaza. Make a third choice. Head to the end of the road and confront your nemesis.
The Audition Shuttle heading to the Dreamplay Fantasia. Make a third choice. Hanunue's spirit will be summoned once more, still engaged in an eternal battle with his enemies.

The Audition Shuttle heading to the Dreamplay Fantasia. Make a third choice. While the spirit of the clock has long departed, its golden heart still resides in the realm of dreams and can be repaired.
The Audition Shuttle heading to the Gunfire Time. Make a third choice. The era is overwhelmingly flustered and vain. If only there were a gale to sweep away all the billboards.
The Audition Shuttle heading to the Gunfire Time. Make a third choice. Head to the end of the road and restore peace to Dreamville once more.
